blocks.text: 14.2 mein ginwai gai pollutants ki gyarah qismein 14.4.1 se 14.4.11 mein yake baad deegre bayan hain: har ek kahan se aata hai aur kya karta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: gyarah pollutant qismon ki table un ke bunyadi zaraye aur har ek par note ke saath, phir qudrati aur insani zaraye. Oopar daen: teen CFC muadle jin mein chlorine radical dobara banta hai. Darmiyan daen: primary aur secondary pollutants. Neeche: jalne, nitrogen oxide aur sulfur oxide ke muadle carbon monoxide, N2O aur PM2.5 par notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Air pollutant ki qismein, un ke zaraye, ozone par CFC ka hamla aur aham muadle (topics 14.2 se 14.4.11 aur Table 14.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Fossil fuel ka jalna zyada tar pollutant qismon ke peechhe hai: carbon monoxide aur carbon dioxide, zyada darja hararat par bane nitrogen oxides, coal aur oil se sulfur oxides, bina jale hydrocarbons, aur na-mukammal jalne ke saath aane wale volatile organic compounds aur polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons. Zameeni satah ki ozone secondary hai, dhoop mein nitrogen oxides aur volatile organics se bani, aur aerosols aur refrigerators se nikle chlorofluorocarbons stratosphere tak ja pohnchte hain, jahan ultraviolet roshni chlorine radicals azad karti hai jo bar bar ozone tabah karte hain. PCBs aur DDT jaise persistent organic pollutants tootne ka muqabla karte aur door tak safar karte hain, particulate matter dhool, aag aur engines se aata hai, aur bhari dhatein dhaat-sazi, batteries aur jalane se.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si pollutant qismein zyada tar na-mukammal jalne se paida hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Carbon monoxide, bina jale hydrocarbons, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, volatile organic compounds aur kajal ka particulate matter sab fuels ke bohat kam oxygen ke saath jalne se bante hain; mukammal jalna zyada tar carbon dioxide aur pani deta hai.

items: 14.4.1 se 14.4.11 gyarah pollutant qismon mein se har ek ke zaraye aur asrat bayan karte hain.
